::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Originally built and operated by Intel as its only fab in China, producing NAND flash — Intel agreed in 2020-2021 to sell its NAND/SSD business, including this fab, to SK Hynix in stages; the entity was formally renamed to reflect full SK Hynix ownership (effective September 1). It is tracked here as a distinct entry from SK Hynix's own Wuxi DRAM fab since it is a different site, product (NAND vs DRAM), and acquisition history.
:::

**Chinese name:** SK海力士半导体（大连）有限公司 (SK Hǎilìshì Bàndǎotǐ (Dàlián) Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

## What does this facility make?

NAND flash memory on 12-inch (300mm) wafers.

## Why does it matter?

A rare case in this tracker of a facility changing foreign owners entirely (Intel to SK Hynix) while remaining a foreign-invested operation in China throughout — distinct from the far more common story of a facility being added to, or dropped from, a US control list.

## Project Timeline

- **Jan 2021** — Intel completes the first phase of selling its NAND/SSD business and Dalian fab to SK Hynix (deal announced 2020)
- **Sep 2026** — Entity formally renamed to reflect full SK Hynix ownership, ending Intel's fab presence in China
